name: Sankyo Frontier
verdict: Sankyo Frontier Co., Ltd., a Tokyo-listed unit-house maker majority-held by the Nagatsuma family's unlisted company Wako Kosan. Nothing found.
aliases: 三協フロンテア株式会社
note: Kit sponsor (front, right collarbone) of Kashiwa Reysol 2026-27 per https://www.reysol.co.jp/news/goods/202627-4.html . Rating note: Wako Kosan (50.54%) is 100% owned by the Nagatsuma family per the securities report, which lists no government holder. Quick company check (2026-09-30): the group has subsidiaries in Myanmar (unit-house rental and drawing work, per the same report); no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found.
